title: Kelsey Cook | Mark Your Territory (Full Comedy Special)
description:
Kelsey Cook recently moved to Minnesota in the dead of winter to live with her boyfriend. In her new special "Mark Your Territory", she's letting audiences in on the perks of dating an older man, the insanity of IUD insertions, navigating a parent with dementia, and much more.

Download and stream Kelsey Cook’s new album Mark Your Territory on all your favorite services: https://800poundgorillamedia.com/products/kelsey-cook-mark-your-territory

Special thanks to every audience member who’s taken the time to come see me on tour and helped me shape this hour of comedy. I couldn't do this job without you, and I’m so damn grateful for the support you continue to show me. Thank you.

This special is dedicated to my brilliant mom, Kathy, who continues to fight against Frontotemporal Dementia.

Mom, you’re without a doubt the strongest person I know and I feel immensely lucky to be your daughter. Throughout this tour, former students of yours and fellow foosball players have come to the shows and told me how much you mean to them and the ways you made their lives better.

It’s been incredibly special to hear the impact you’ve made on so many people. Thank you for being so hilarious at every stage of your life and inspiring me to try and find any light in the darkness of disease. I wish I could have you with me at all my shows, but at least getting to talk about you on stage makes me feel like you’re there with me.

I love you forever.
